name: bigfish-ink-wash-photo
title_zh: 不重绘只锚定主体走向，落笔前先定画心与延展向
tagline_zh: 不是精确重建，只保留关键的识别锚点；生成前先看照片定画幅方向，按主体延展、空间流向和视觉中心分布来定。
tagline_en: Not reconstruction — only essential identifying anchors; canvas direction is decided from the photo's subject extension and visual center before generating.
desc_en: Not reconstruction — only essential identifying anchors; canvas direction is decided from the photo's subject extension and visual center before generating.
why_zh: 它明确要避开两种假货：贴上去的写实主体，和果冻感的 AI 水彩笔触。
why_en: It explicitly avoids two fakes: photorealistic pasted subjects, and jelly-like AI watercolor marks.
limit_zh: 要先读完 references/generation-prompt.md 才动手——作者写成了硬步骤。只保留锚点意味着细节大量丢失，想认出人脸的别装。只出图。
limit_en: Read references/generation-prompt.md in full first — a hard step. Anchors only means heavy detail loss.
title_en: Anchor subject & canvas direction first, then ink-wash
